title: Core Awakening
tagline: Rebuild your identity from the remains of fallen Titans.
pitch: Engage in tactical arena combat as a modular mech, dismantling enemies to recover valuable components while navigating their attacks. Your choices shape your power and identity as you evolve through strategic decision-making.
coreLoop: The player reads enemy attack intents, evades, targets specific subsystems, and decides how to salvage the defeated foe's components, with each choice impacting their mech's capabilities.

mechanics.name: Read and Evade
mechanics.description: Players must interpret enemy attack telegraphs to evade incoming attacks effectively.

mechanics.name: Target Subsystems
mechanics.description: Each enemy has multiple subsystems that can be targeted, influencing the outcome of the fight based on which is destroyed or preserved.

mechanics.name: Three-Way Decision Making
mechanics.description: After defeating an enemy, players choose to install, secure, or dismantle salvaged components, affecting their mech's abilities.

controls.keyboard: WASD for movement, mouse for aiming and targeting
controls.mouse: click to target specific subsystems and make decisions

artDirection.mood: cold steel with warm salvage highlights

audioDirection.musicMood: sci-fi ambient with a mechanical undertone

difficulty.start: easy to read telegraphs and simple enemy patterns
difficulty.progression: introducing more complex patterns and tougher decisions
difficulty.peak: max difficulty with multiple attack types and crucial strategic choices

winLose.win: defeat the enemy and secure components for your mech
winLose.lose: fail to evade or manage enemy attacks, resulting in the destruction of your mech

juice.particles: when components are salvaged or installed
juice.hitStop: when an enemy attack is successfully evaded
juice.flash: when a player makes the three-way decision

scopeNotes: Do not build procedural dungeons, multiple enemy types, bosses, inventory systems, narrative scenes, or between-run upgrades.

scoreEvents: score increases when an enemy is defeated and components are salvaged
